source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening, the Recalling box and topic 18.1, block for block (PDF 84).

blocks.text: Aap Grade X mein Mendel ki genetics ki buniyadi baatein parh chuke hain. Yeh chapter is baat ko aage le ja kar Mendel ke baad hone wali research (tehqeeq) batata hai. Is mein moroosi (inherited, yaani walidain se aane wali) bimariyan, un ki alamaat (symptoms) aur ilaaj bhi hai.

blocks.title: Recalling (yaad karein)
blocks.text: Austria ke aik monk (rahib) Gregor Johann Mendel ne sab se pehle samjhaya ke khasiyatein walidain se bachchon mein kaise jati hain (inheritance). Us ne matar ke true-breeding (pure-breeding, yaani khalis nasl) paude tayyar kiye. Jo paudha kisi khasiyat ke liye true-breeding ho, woh self-fertilization (apne hi pollen se fertilization) par sab bachche usi khasiyat wale deta hai.

Mendel ne matar ke paudon mein monohybrid crosses kiye, yaani aik waqt mein sirf aik khasiyat dekhi. Pehle cross mein us ne beej ki shakal (seed shape) dekhi. Jab us ne true-breeding gol (round) beej wale paude ko jhurridar (wrinkled) beej wale paude se milaya to F1 nasl ke sab paudon ne gol beej diye. Jo khasiyat F1 mein nazar aayi (gol beej) us ko us ne dominant kaha, aur jo khasiyat F1 mein nazar nahi aayi (jhurridar beej) us ko recessive kaha.

Jab F1 paudon ko self-pollinate kiya gaya to F2 ke 1/4 beej jhurridar the. Yaani F2 mein dominant aur recessive ki ratio (nisbat) 3 dominant : 1 recessive thi. Mendel ke nataij se pata chala ke F2 ki yeh 3:1 ratio asal mein chhupi hui 1:2:1 ratio hai.

items: 2/4 dominant the lekin pure-breeding nahi the (Rr),

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: 3 gol : 1 jhurridar sirf shakal ki ginti hai. Andar se 3 gol mein 1 RR aur 2 Rr hain, is liye genotype ki ginti 1 RR : 2 Rr : 1 rr banti hai. Yahi 'chhupi hui 1:2:1' hai.

blocks.prompt: Khalis nasl ke gol beej wale matar ko jhurridar beej wale se milaya. F1 beej kaise honge, aur kaun si khasiyat dominant hai?
blocks.explanation: Sab F1 beej gol honge. Gol dominant hai kyunke F1 mein yahi nazar aati hai; jhurridar recessive hai, jo F1 mein chhup jati hai aur F2 ke 1/4 beejon mein wapas aati hai.

items: Mendel ne khalis nasl (true-breeding) matar ke paude banaye aur aik khasiyat ke monohybrid crosses kiye.
Gol x jhurridar: sab F1 gol; gol dominant, jhurridar recessive.
F1 ki self-pollination: F2 mein 3 gol : 1 jhurridar, jo asal mein 1 RR : 2 Rr : 1 rr hai.
